content.description:
My art is a commentary and pushes back to the closed world of the establishment art world that has for so long put their noses up to the "others".

Well, here we go: NFTs and crypto have come to let them know that they can no longer gate-keep us. We will see new forms of artists come out and lose others that cannot adapt (which is sad). Even though I am doing this as a commentary to what can be called traditional art, I believe in the power of emotions and that my works bring them out. This is what art is to me, the bringing out of an emotional response to a sense, be it visual, auditory, or any other sense you might choose to engage as a viewer and as an artist.
